title: plagianthus lyallii
intro: Plagianthus lyallii, commonly known as New Zealand tea tree, is a plant species native to New Zealand that has been traditionally used for medicinal purposes. The health benefits of Plagianthus lyallii include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm and reduce anxiety, promoting relaxation and a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of Plagianthus lyallii include flavonoids, terpenes, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
